title: Ever Works — Agent Template Skills (skills.yml)
description: Default skills attached when an Agent template is selected in the Create Agent wizard. Skill slugs resolve against the forthcoming ever-works/skills catalog. Unknown slugs are ignored by the wizard, not rejected.

required.description: Skills the wizard auto-attaches and locks. The user can remove them but the wizard warns.

recommended.description: Skills the wizard pre-checks but leaves the user free to deselect.

slug.description: Skill slug, kebab-case. Resolves against ever-works/skills.

why.description: Short justification shown as a tooltip in the wizard.
